inv.desc_en:
REF 4597867

InmoOlaya offers you this Barcelona Musical Bar Transfer, in L'Eixample, Located near the city's nightlife par excellence, we also find the city's trendy gastronomic venues, with a wide range of tapas, dishes, brunch, pizzerias….

It has a C3 Mixed license, a space of 240 square meters, with a beautiful facade of 5 meters and an interior capacity of 120 people, It also has a terrace with 3 tables and 12 seats, in addition to an eventual extension by covid of 2 tables and another eight seats.Spacious and totally open-plan, with high ceilings.

For its operation it has; a small kitchen with an iron, stove and deep fryer.

Transfer 385.€ 000 Rent 3.000 €

Contact us for more information and / or to schedule an appointment at our offices.
